releaseNote.summary: AI agent states (stateType 6): sys-agents components alone or as a team, inline tools with approval, session memory; MCP task type 24; agent-runs function.

aiAgentState.description: stateType 6 (AiAgent) with an 'agent' block: agent (sys-agents ref), prompt (template with {{ data.* }} or IAgentPromptMapping, messages[] seed messages, context {name: path} data blocks), output.path, memory override, tools.exclude, decision {mode model|rules|script, fallback (required), exclude, hints, hintsMapping, mapping, onExhausted}, policy (narrows only). Runs at pipeline order 65 (not on updateData); the decision is consumed by the automatic-transition step of the same hop. Rule-less automatic transitions of the state are the candidates; without an in-hop decision they never fire. The structured output and a $agent summary are merged under output.path in one data write. sys-agents component: provider (AiAgent:Providers profile name), instructions, inline tools (kind 1 task, 2 script dynamicExpresso|C#, 3 mcp), memory {mode none|state|flow|key, storage local|provider, maxMessages, compaction trim|summarize, retentionDays, resetOn}, output.schema, policy, audit. Journal tables InstanceAgentRuns, InstanceAgentToolCalls, InstanceAgentDecisions, AgentSessions (gzip, not encrypted). Kill switch AiAgent:Enabled.

mcpTask.description: Task type 24 (Mcp): calls an MCP server over streamable HTTP from the orchestration host. config: endpoint (host must be in Mcp:AllowedHosts), operation callTool|listTools|readResource|listResources|getPrompt|listPrompts, tool|uri|prompt, arguments, auth {header, scheme, secretRef}, headers {name: {secretRef}} (plain-text values rejected), timeoutSeconds (1..120). Input/output follow IMapping.

agentRunsFunction.description: Instance system function 'agent-runs': agent runs newest first with the decision and participant. ?runId= returns one run with its tool calls, &include=transcript adds the transcript audit.transcript kept (summary: response; full: input and response); ?state=, ?skip=, ?take= page the list. POST {domain}/definitions/agents/{key}/dry-run runs an agent once with stub tools for the roles in AiAgent:DryRun:Roles.

aiAgentToolApproval.description: Tool requiresApproval: a run that stops on such a call journals it ApprovalPending, writes $agent.pendingApprovals and takes decision.onApprovalRequest (an automatic transition to any state). Re-entering the agent state with body {approval: {approved, callId?, reason?} | [...]} resumes the conversation from its session; an unanswered call is denied.

aiAgentTeams.description: agent.mode single|sequential|concurrent|handoff with agents[] {name, agent, description}. Sequential/concurrent participants run before the lead, which receives their outputs as <data name="participant:…"> blocks and decides; handoff runs the lead as a router whose output names the participant that answers and decides. Participant runs are journaled with InstanceAgentRuns.Participant.
